6.content:
claude.md -- 1st Central Digital T&Cs (Customer Review, DEMO)

Purpose: customer-facing read-and-accept screen, opened from the link the Agent tree emails/texts. Own session (session_id set by Agent node 6) so the agent tree can read the result back via CO 1197. Cloned from the consent-form demo customer tree 415521914.

Node map: 4 Get Terms (root, resolves terms_score -> text/document/product/version) -> 1 Policy Terms (read + "I confirm I have read and understood" checkbox + signature) -> 7 Stamp Acceptance (NEW) -> 5 terms_score contains "addons"? -> 3 Optional Extras (two required selects + signature) -> 2 Confirmation Received.

Data dictionary: in via URL: terms_score, policy_number, customer_name. Node 4: terms_instruction, document_name, product, document_version, presented_at_iso (form), transforms.terms_html. Node 1: is_terms_accepted, terms_signature. Node 7: terms_accepted_at, terms_accepted_at_iso, terms_version_accepted, terms_acceptance_status. Node 3: addon_legal_protection, addon_breakdown, addons_signature.

Conventions: project script_code carries the source tree's qcf- styling and progress header, relabelled (Start / Policy Terms / Optional Extras / Submit). termsData is duplicated in Agent node 17 -- keep in sync.

Gotchas: all T&Cs wording is demo sample text. A customer who leaves the checkbox unticked still completes the flow; the agent tree routes them to "Acceptance Not Received".

Changelog

  • 2026-10-20 -- Created from the consent-form demo customer tree 415521914 (2026-09-01 version) for the 1st Central Digital T&Cs demo. Swapped the consent dictionary for the sample T&Cs catalogue, renamed variables, replaced the optional research consent with an Optional Extras screen, added node 7 (acceptance timestamp/version stamp) between nodes 1 and 5, rebranded the project script_code labels.
